body:
Nav.kt hardcodes startDestination = Routes.LOGIN and nothing ever checks
SessionStore.token at startup, so every cold start lands on a completely blank
login form (server URL, email, password all empty) even though a valid bearer
token sits in EncryptedSharedPreferences and the server URL in DataStore. Users
must retype everything on every launch — for a phone app this is the single
biggest usability defect in the repo.

Fix: when a token exists, start at lastOpenedListId ?: Overview (same logic as
LoginViewModel.startDestinationAfterLogin); land on Login only when there is no
token. Also prefill the server URL field from ServerConfig when Login IS shown
(it currently starts empty even though the config persists), and keep the
401-driven return-to-login path working (ErrorInterceptor already throws
UnauthorizedException; nothing currently navigates on it from arbitrary screens
— cover at least: token revoked remotely -> next foreground sync 401s -> user
must be routed to Login, not left on silently-stale screens).

Files: ui/Nav.kt, ui/login/LoginViewModel.kt (+Screen), MainActivity.kt.
title: Android: no session resume — every app start demands full re-login
